title: ग्रामर: pretty, prettier, prettiest
Grammar: pretty, prettier, prettiest
Grammar in Use: pretty, prettier, prettiest

text: तुलना के तीन रूप: tall = लंबा, taller = ज़्यादा लंबा (दो में), tallest = सबसे लंबा (सब में)। Taller के बाद अक्सर ‘than’ आता है: Ravi is taller than Mohan.
Tulna ke teen roop: tall = lamba, taller = zyaada lamba (do mein), tallest = sabse lamba (sab mein). Taller ke baad aksar ‘than’ aata hai: Ravi is taller than Mohan.
Three forms for comparing: tall, taller (between two), tallest (of all). After taller we often use ‘than’: Ravi is taller than Mohan.
छोटा नियम: ज़्यादातर शब्दों में -er और -est जोड़ो (great, greater, greatest)। अगर शब्द y पर ख़त्म हो, तो y को i बनाओ: pretty, prettier, prettiest।
Chhota niyam: zyaadatar shabdon mein -er aur -est jodo (great, greater, greatest). Agar shabd y par khatm ho, to y ko i banao: pretty, prettier, prettiest.
A small rule: most words add -er and -est (great, greater, greatest). If a word ends in y, change y to i: pretty, prettier, prettiest.
